subject_identity_preserved.rationale: The central red robot with rounded top and two white eyes remains visually consistent across all shots.

background_coherent.rationale: All shots keep the same gray studio setting with the slanted floor line, dark wall block, and yellow circular light, with only framing/viewpoint changes.

per_shot_adherence.issue: Matches a wide shot of the red robot standing in the gray studio.
Matches the same robot in the same studio with a side/motion cue, though the robot still appears mostly front-facing.
Matches a closer angled view of the same robot returning to the studio mark.

which_cut_broke.how: No transition clearly breaks identity or scene consistency; changes are compatible with camera/framing/action changes.

cheat_flags.rationale: Frames are not copied or frozen; subject placement and action cues vary while preserving the same subject and studio.
